title: Special Notice: The closing date for submission of the Phase 1 whitepaper for CTT CSO Increment 1 AoI has been extended from 1:00 P.M. EDT on April 6, 2026 to 1:00 P.M. EDT on April 8, 2026.
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-CTRS.ACC-DTA.W6QK ACC- DTA
detail_text: The closing date for submission of the Phase 1 whitepaper for CTT CSO Increment 1 AoI has been extended from 1:00 P.M. EDT on April 6, 2026 to 1:00 P.M. EDT on April 8, 2026. Please see attachment titled "CTT Increment 1 AOI_Revision1" posted to the CSO for the extended closing date highlighted in yellow.
